'''Fabrillan City Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in [[Fabrillan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malthor]]. [[Reginna Bel Typolla]] worked at Fabrillan City Spaceport as a docking attendant.
